meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a local server when available and offering an evaluation server when none exists.

copy.tagline: 给 Mattermost 添加机器人频道,自动复用本地或评估服务器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队用 Mattermost 需要快速接入机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Add a Mattermost bot channel, auto-reusing local or evaluation server
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses Mattermost and needs to quickly add a bot channel

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Mattermost 收发私信和频道消息、处理文件与表情回应，并发送带交互按钮的审批卡片。消息经 WebSocket 到达，卡片点击通过 HTTP 回调返回。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加 Mattermost 频道或机器人、接入 Mattermost 时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Mattermost 频道
say.note: 开始发现并配置 Mattermost 服务器。

say.text: 通过 Mattermost 给我发消息
say.note: 经 Mattermost 私信与你对话。
发送可点击的审批卡片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can communicate via Mattermost: it handles DMs, channels, threads, files, reactions, and interactive approval cards. Messages arrive over WebSocket; card clicks return via an authenticated HTTP callback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add a Mattermost channel or bot, or to integrate Mattermost.

say_en.text: Send me a message via Mattermost.
Post an approval card to Mattermost.
